description: This file defines the OrleansException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime for error reporting. It provides multiple constructors for creating exceptions with default messages, custom messages, inner exceptions, and supports serialization.

classes.name: OrleansException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Orleans runtime error reporting, derived from System.Exception, supporting serialization and multiple constructors.

methods.name: OrleansException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a generic message.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: OrleansException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a custom message and an inner exception for exception chaining.
